title: Frequently updated applications have not been repackaged

maxAgeDays.text: Days before a frequently updated package is stale

report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'application has', 'applications have')} not been repackaged for more than {params.maxAgeDays} days

messages.businessImpact: Applications such as browsers and runtimes publish security fixes monthly. A package six months old installs a version with known vulnerabilities on every new device.
remediation: Repackage from the current release, or move the application to a source that updates itself.
messages.cannotSee: Requires the discovered applications inventory, which is out of scope for the first release. Ships disabled and is enabled when that collection area is added.
